_purpose: A real transition ledger for three verified landings. Trees and parents are read from git, not transcribed. Each subject records ONE transition, COMMITTING -> EFFECTIVE, with a genesis justification: these landings predate the ledger, so their earlier transitions were never observed. The first draft recorded DETECTED -> ELIGIBLE -> EFFECTIVE, which the state machine (FWK-103) proved impossible -- DETECTED -> ELIGIBLE is not an edge. The landings were real; that PATH was not. RECORDED_PATH != OBSERVED_PATH.

transitions.genesis_justification: Imported from a pre-ledger landing. The transitions before COMMITTING were never recorded, because the ledger did not exist when they occurred. Recording an invented path to satisfy continuity would fabricate history to please a control.
